title: Verify recovery, retention and production configuration
objective: The system can recover without losing evidence or silently changing public truth.
outcome: A fixture restore/rollback of staged evidence and N-1 publication is timed through existing recovery ports. A configuration file, backup listing, planned drill, or earlier static Worker rollback target is not a managed restore/failover result. AUTH-05 managed drills remain unrun. Retention, replay, rotation, and cursor invalidation stay fixture-scoped and do not erase historical approved evidence. Secrets stay out of logs. Unwanted Cloudflare Insights remains disabled and CSP is not broadened. Fresh browser captures remain untested; the 2026-09-10 F31 console record is historical, not a current capture. Health/readiness names actual static-corpus dependencies. Failure recovery cannot publish pending scientific claims. C-009-1 remains unresolved. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task.

commits.subject: Exercise evidence and publication recovery
commits.instructions: Restore a staged evidence/accepted-metadata snapshot and return to N-1 publication using existing recovery ports. Preserve attempts and review histories.
commits.verification: Measure actual restore/rollback time; a configuration file or backup listing alone is not a recovery drill.

commits.subject: Verify retention and key operation
commits.instructions: Check sample/metadata retention classes, quota behavior, job stop/replay, credential rotation and cursor invalidation through scoped tests. Keep secrets out of logs.
commits.verification: Deletion/rotation tests use fixtures or staging; historical approved evidence is not erased to make integrity checks pass.

commits.subject: Resolve configuration and console inconsistencies
commits.instructions: Decide whether the unwanted Insights injection should be removed or intentionally configured under the site's privacy/CSP policy. Align health/readiness signals with actual dependencies.
commits.verification: Fresh browser captures show the selected behavior without unexpected script errors; CSP is not broadly weakened as a shortcut.
